name: Can I add plumbing or HVAC to my detached garage?

mainEntity.name: Can I add plumbing or HVAC to my detached garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, plumbing and HVAC systems can be added to a detached garage, significantly enhancing its functionality, especially if you plan to use it as a workshop, home office, or living space. Adding plumbing for a utility sink or restroom requires trenching for water and sewer lines, while HVAC involves extending ductwork or installing a dedicated mini-split system. Both additions will require specific permits and licensed professionals to ensure proper installation and compliance with local building and health codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, plumbing (for sinks, restrooms) and HVAC (for heating/cooling) can be added to a detached garage, but require specific permits and professional installation.
